text_markup: Some abilities instruct the Corp to "install and rez" a card. To resolve this instruction, the Corp first installs the card normally. After the installation is complete, the Corp rezzes the card. See also {ref:rule_reveal_for_install_and_rez}.
text_plain: Some abilities instruct the Corp to "install and rez" a card. To resolve this instruction, the Corp first installs the card normally. After the installation is complete, the Corp rezzes the card. See also rule 8.5.13d.
